gloss: breaking and entering; home invasion; burglary (using force)

definitions.gloss: breaking and entering; home invasion; forced-entry robbery
definitions.explanation: Forced entry into a residence or business, typically to commit robbery, often while the occupants are inside. Also refers by extension to the person who does this. A standard term in crime news reports.

examples.japanese: {押|お}し{入|い}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧、⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}{街|がい}→住宅街：09394_juutakugai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{押|お}し{入|い}り⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Late at night, there was a home invasion in the residential neighborhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近隣|きんりん}→近隣：14361_kinrin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{相次|あいつ}いで⟦{発生|はっせい}している→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧{押|お}し{入|い}り⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The police are investigating the suspect behind the string of home-invasion robberies in the area.

notes:
Noun formed from the verb ⟦{押|お}し{入|い}る→押し入る：06760_oshiiru⟧ ('to force one's way into'). Frequently appears in compounds and news headlines describing forced-entry crimes. Unlike a quiet burglary, {押|お}し{入|い}り implies aggressive or violent entry, often with occupants present.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {押|お}し{入|い}り⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧: home-invasion robbery (very common in news)
- {押|お}し{入|い}り⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: break-in incident
- {押|お}し{入|い}り{犯|はん}: the perpetrator of a break-in
- {押|お}し{入|い}りにあう: to be the victim of a break-in
- {押|お}し{入|い}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: a break-in occurs

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{押|お}し{入|い}る→押し入る：06760_oshiiru⟧: to force one's way in (the base verb)
- ⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧: robbery; robber — the broader crime category
- ⟦{空|あ}き{巣|す}→空き巣：15343_akisu⟧: burglary when the house is empty — contrasts with {押|お}し{入|い}り, which often happens with occupants home
- ⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}→侵入：11440_shinnyuu⟧: intrusion, unlawful entry — more general; includes non-violent trespass
- ⟦{不法|ふほう}{侵入|しんにゅう}→不法侵入：17433_fuhoushinnyuu⟧: illegal entry; trespassing

USAGE:
Standard term in crime reporting. In news stories it is usually followed by ⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧ or ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧. In casual speech, ⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧ alone is often enough; {押|お}し{入|い}り emphasizes the forced, aggressive nature of the entry.
